# SAM SHAHEEN

[contact line copied exactly from the champion]

## EMBEDDED PLATFORM & INTEGRATION ENGINEER, CENTRALIZED ADAS COMPUTE

Youngest engineer in Bosch history to reach Senior Software Engineer. Seven years shipping safety-critical ADAS software where silicon meets software: bootloaders, linker scripts, multi-core debug, and camera image pipelines. Most recently software architect and integration lead on a centralized ADAS domain controller consolidating five sensor stacks onto a GPU-equipped Linux SoC. Previously built a 360° camera platform's delivery system from zero to 100+ releases across 12+ OEM vehicle lines; software now on the road in 1M+ vehicles.

## EXPERIENCE

### Senior Software Engineer / Lead Software Integrator, Robert Bosch LLC

Detroit, MI · Feb 2019 – Jan 2026

#### Software Architect & Integration Product Owner, Next-Gen ADAS Domain Controller

2024 – 2026

Bosch's largest-ever ADAS program (1,000+ engineers): one centralized Linux platform replacing distributed ECUs, with driving, parking, camera, radar, and ultrasonic stacks on a single GPU-equipped TI SoC.

- Designed the platform's memory architecture as Software Architect reporting to the program's head of software: replaced hand-edited linker files across 60 repositories with a YAML single source of truth and Python generators producing every .ld, .lds, and .map file, deployed via Conan, eliminating a full-time manual Excel process and a standing safety risk in RAM and flash allocation.
- North America Product Owner of software integration: owned the Complete Software repository, the convergence point where 100+ Conan-versioned component repositories from every sensor stack became the single fully testable system.
- Ran the cloud build infrastructure: nightly and weekly builds with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation, automated releases with notes generated from PR annotations, and integration tests gating every handoff to requirements-based validation.
- Held accept/negotiate/decline authority over every line item of the OEM's software-integration requirements; authored the end-to-end integration specification covering repository mirroring, build cadence, and coverage standards.
- Ran a 24/7 follow-the-sun integration operation with a German counterpart, aligning dependencies across ~12 domain product owners and the program's heads of software, hardware, and validation.

#### Lead Software Integrator, 360° Camera ADAS Platform

2019 – 2024

- Led the ECU migration from Xilinx Zynq ZU4 to ZU2: reworked memory layout, bootloader, boot manager, and multi-core BSW for the new silicon; wrote the Lauterbach flashing scripts and owned multi-core fault isolation across HSM, bootloader, and application layers.
- Joined six months into development with no repository, build toolchain, CI/CD, or release process; built the complete delivery system from zero and shipped 100+ releases across 12+ parallel OEM programs, hitting start of production on schedule.
- Built the full build toolchain and Jenkins/Bitbucket CI/CD framework (ARMv8, Clang, Green Hills, CMake) serving ~100 daily developers: three-target system builds in ~30 minutes on every PR, incremental builds in single-digit minutes.
- Owned the production cybersecurity pipeline: binary encryption, public/private key swapping for factory builds, and diagnostic lockdown, plus branching strategy and factory industrialization builds for the manufacturing floor.
- Integrated FPGA bitfile updates across BSW, handling memory-layout changes and IPC/ICC reconfiguration; built custom streaming scripts to pipe camera image output before the ECU could process it natively.
- Final technical escalation for 140+ engineers worldwide across BSW, image chain, computer vision, and parking algorithms; reviewed and merged 2,000+ pull requests as the platform's quality gate.
- Grew the integration team from one to ten engineers across the US, India, and Budapest with performance-review responsibility for all reports; presented program status and risk mitigation directly to executives at Stellantis and other OEMs.
- Cut 4-hour full-stack QAC static-analysis scans to minutes by diffing build artifacts and delta-scanning only changed code, enforcing a zero-new-findings gate on every PR.
- Compressed OEM release turnaround from ~4 days to same-day through layered automated verification: per-build smoke tests, automated ECU integration tests, and nightly in-vehicle validation.
- Co-owned the task scheduler on a platform at 100% of CPU runtime budget by launch, continuously rebalancing function calls across periodic task rates to fit the full feature set and resolve timing failures surfacing elsewhere in the system.

### Software Engineer Co-op, Midmark Corporation

Versailles, OH · Aug 2017 – Aug 2018

- Wrote embedded firmware in C with FDA-compliant VectorCAST testing toward the team's 100% coverage standard; scripted automated overnight hardware test suites in an EMC chamber validating Bluetooth signal integrity.
- Traced the flagship product's Bluetooth pairing failure to an incorrectly invoked API call, directly unblocking product launch; built a C# diagnostic tool that extracted and analyzed embedded device data from field and QA returns.

### EECS Lab Teaching Assistant, University of Toledo

Toledo, OH · Sep – Dec 2018

- Taught weekly Python classes to 25 students and led digital-logic and circuit-analysis hardware labs, grading all coursework.

## EARLY TECHNICAL WORK

### Co-founder, HellsGamers Steam Gaming Community

Online · 2008 – 2011

- Co-founded and scaled one of the largest Steam communities to ~250,000 members; self-taught Python and Lua to build and run game-server infrastructure across Windows and Linux serving thousands of concurrent players.

## TECHNICAL SKILLS

**Embedded & Platform:** Embedded Linux, AUTOSAR/BSW, bootloaders & boot managers, memory architecture & linker scripts (.ld/.lds/.map), multi-core debugging (Lauterbach), SoC porting & bring-up (Xilinx Zynq ZU4/ZU2, TI), GPU-equipped SoC integration, FPGA integration, ISO 26262, RTOS, CAN, IPC/ICC, zero-copy middleware

**Build, Release & DevOps:** Conan, CMake, Clang, Green Hills, ARMv8 toolchains, Jenkins, Git/Bitbucket, QAC static analysis, cloud build infrastructure, CI/CD & release automation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, binary encryption & key management, factory industrialization tooling

**Languages:** C, C++, Python, C#, Lua, Assembly, CAPL, YAML

**ADAS & Vision:** 360° surround view, camera calibration (intrinsic/extrinsic), image stitching & image chain, AEB, lane keeping, automated parking, ultrasonic sensor fusion

**Leadership:** Global team of 10 across 3 regions, final escalation ownership, OEM requirements negotiation, executive customer communication

**Spoken Languages:** English (native), Arabic (fluent), Portuguese (proficient)

## EDUCATION

B.S. Computer Science Engineering, University of Toledo · Toledo, OH · Dec 2018
